ApiKey.description_en: The API key information. Describes an API key used to access sandbox services, including its ownership, status, and access control configurations
ApiKey.description_zh: API Key 信息。描述一个用于访问沙箱服务的 API Key 及其归属、状态和访问控制配置

apiKeyID.description_en: The unique identifier of the API key, in UUID format
apiKeyID.description_zh: API Key 的唯一标识，为 UUID 格式

apiKeyMask.description_en: The masked value of the API key. The prefix and the first and last four characters are retained, and the middle portion is replaced with four asterisks. This value is used for secure display in the user interface
apiKeyMask.description_zh: API Key 的掩码值，保留前缀和首尾各 4 位字符，中间以 4 个星号代替，用于在界面上安全展示

apiKeyName.description_en: The name of the API key. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, spaces, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.)
apiKeyName.description_zh: API Key 名称。长度不超过 128 个字符，仅支持字母、数字、空格以及短横线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句点（.）

apiKeyValue.description_en: The plaintext value of the API key, prefixed with e2b_. This value is returned only in responses from the create, import, and reset operations. Other operations do not return this value
apiKeyValue.description_zh: API Key 明文值，以 e2b_ 开头。仅在创建、导入和重置接口的响应中返回，其余接口不返回

createdTime.description_en: The time when the API key was created, in UTC and RFC 3339 format
createdTime.description_zh: API Key 的创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339

expireTime.description_en: The time when the API key expires, in UTC and RFC 3339 format. An empty value indicates that the API key never expires
expireTime.description_zh: API Key 的过期时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339。留空表示永不过期

ipBlacklist.description_en: The IP blacklist. After configuration, IP addresses in the list cannot use this API key. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ipWhitelist
ipBlacklist.description_zh: IP 黑名单。配置后列表内的 IP 地址不能使用该 API Key。与 ipWhitelist 互斥

items.description_zh: 单条 IP 访问控制规则

ipWhitelist.description_en: The IP address whitelist. After configuration, only IP addresses in the list can use this API key. This parameter is mutually exclusive with ipBlacklist
ipWhitelist.description_zh: IP 白名单。配置后仅列表内的 IP 地址可以使用该 API Key。与 ipBlacklist 互斥

items.description_zh: 单条 IP 访问控制规则

lastUsedTime.description_en: The time when the API key was last used, in UTC and RFC 3339 format. An empty value indicates that the API key has never been used
lastUsedTime.description_zh: API Key 最近一次被使用的时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339。从未使用时为空

resourceGroupID.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID to which the team belongs
resourceGroupID.description_zh: 团队所属的阿里云资源组 ID

source.description_en:
The source of the API key. Valid values:
generated: The API key is generated by the service.
custom: The API key is imported by the user
source.description_zh: API Key 的来源。取值：generated（由服务生成）、custom（由用户导入）

status.description_en:
The status of the API key. Valid values:
active: The API key is enabled.
inactive: The API key is disabled. A disabled API key cannot be used to access sandbox services
status.description_zh: API Key 状态。取值：active（启用）、inactive（停用）。停用后该 Key 不能再用于访问沙箱服务

teamID.description_en: The ID of the team to which the resource belongs, in UUID format
teamID.description_zh: 资源所属团队的 ID，为 UUID 格式

teamPlan.description_en:
The team plan. Valid values:
eco: economy
std: standard
pro: professional
ent: enterprise
teamPlan.description_zh: 团队套餐规格。取值：eco（经济型）、std（标准型）、pro（专业型）、ent（企业型）

userID.description_en: The user ID of the resource creator, in UUID format
userID.description_zh: 资源创建者的用户 ID，为 UUID 格式

username.description_en: The username of the API key creator
username.description_zh: API Key 创建者的用户名

IPConfig.description_en: The IP access control rule. Describes an IP address or CIDR block used for API key access control
IPConfig.description_zh: IP 访问控制规则。描述一条用于 API Key 访问控制的 IP 地址或网段

description.description_en: The description of the IP rule. The description can be up to 128 characters in length
description.description_zh: 该条 IP 规则的备注说明，长度不超过 128 个字符

ipAddress.description_en: The IPv4 address or CIDR block. IPv6 is not supported
ipAddress.description_zh: IPv4 地址或 CIDR 网段，暂不支持 IPv6

description_zh: 查询指定 API Key 的详细信息
name: DescribeApiKey

items.description_zh: 单条 IP 黑名单规则
单条 IP 白名单规则

message.description_zh: 响应消息。成功时为 success
